summary: Voters in Nehtaur mostly credit a house and ration and farmer cards for relatives, better roads, a girls' school repair, safety and restored bus service to Nehtaur, while the main complaints are the repeatedly closed Nahtaur railway gate and a dilapidated bus stand, with district-level power cuts and stray cattle also raised.

positives.english: My relative got a house, and ration and farmer cards have also been made
positives.hindi: मेरे रिश्तेदार को मकान मिला है, राशन और किसान कार्ड भी बने हैं
positives.basis: An unnamed Nehtaur resident said a relative received a house and that ration and farmer cards were issued (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). Benefit delivered; the speaker is not named.

positives.hindi: सड़कों में भी सुधार हुआ है
positives.basis: A trader said roads have improved (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). No specific road is named in the article.

positives.english: The girls' school building was in bad shape earlier, and now it has been improved
positives.hindi: बालिका विद्यालय की इमारत पहले खराब थी, अब सुधार हुआ है
positives.basis: A trader said education has improved, citing a girls' school building that was dilapidated and has been upgraded (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). The school is not named in the article; the quote is cut short in the source.

positives.english: The security situation has become better
positives.hindi: सुरक्षा की स्थिति बेहतर हुई है
positives.basis: A trader said the security situation has improved; another trader said traders now feel secure carrying cash, where they used to feel unsafe (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026).

positives.english: Buses to Nehtaur from Balawali are running again
positives.hindi: बालावाली से नहटौर तक फिर बसें चलने लगी हैं
positives.basis: Direct bus service was restored: 12 buses from Balawali to Nehtaur started on 24 Feb 2023 via Mandawar, Kiratpur and Shadipur; passengers change buses at Kiratpur because the Kiratpur market road is narrow (Amar Ujala, Bijnor, 24 Feb 2023). Only the ARTO is quoted; no resident is quoted. This is a 2023 source; continued operation after 2023 is not verified.

negatives.english: The Nahtaur railway gate has been closed for many days and people are very troubled
negatives.hindi: नहटौर का रेल फाटक कई दिन से बंद है, लोग बहुत परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Nahtaur road railway gate, inside the AC (Nehtaur municipal board per Wikipedia extent). On 22 Mar 2026 the gate had been shut for about 15 days for track repair; residents said it had not reopened after the first closure date of 12 March, and railway officials said work was on a war footing with no reopening date (Amar Ujala, Dhampur dateline, 22 Mar 2026). On 27 Apr 2026 it was reported fully closed for 20 days for track repair; residents said commuters must use the overbridge in the heat to reach SDM, CO, tehsil and other offices across the tracks, and railway officers gave no reopening date (Amar Ujala, Dhampur dateline, 27 Apr 2026).

negatives.english: The bus stand is very dilapidated
negatives.hindi: नहटौर का बस स्टैंड बहुत जर्जर हो गया है
negatives.basis: Nahtaur town bus stand, inside the AC (Nehtaur municipal board; article datelined Nahtaur). Amar Ujala (9 Apr 2026) calls it dilapidated (जर्जर). The government plans PPP/DBFOT redevelopment with a waiting hall, commercial complex, CCTV, digital boards and parking, approved under a statewide 49-stand scheme; no start or completion date is given. No resident is quoted; the complaint is the reporter's description.

negatives.english: Power is cut too often for no reason, so it should be stopped
negatives.hindi: बिना वजह बिजली बहुत कटती है, इसे रोका जाए
negatives.basis: District-level, not Nehtaur-specific: BKU (Tikait) workers' memorandum to the Dhampur tehsildar (Dhampur dateline, 10 Jun 2026) demanded stopping 'अंधाधुंध' (indiscriminate) power cuts. No Nehtaur village or town is named.

negatives.english: Stray animals should be caught and sent to cow shelters
negatives.hindi: आवारा पशुओं को पकड़कर गोशाला भिजवाया जाए
negatives.basis: District-level, not Nehtaur-specific: the same BKU memorandum to the Dhampur tehsildar (10 Jun 2026) demanded catching stray animals and sending them to gaushalas. No Nehtaur place is named.

negatives.english: A leopard kept roaming near the village and people stayed scared
negatives.hindi: गांव के पास गुलदार घूमता रहा, लोग डरे रहे
negatives.basis: Aaj Tak (Bijnor dateline, 6 Sep 2026): a leopard roamed Sadaruddinagar village, placed in the 'Nahtaur area' (नहटौर क्षेत्र), for several days; the forest department set a cage and trapped it about five days later. The village is not named in the Wikipedia extent text, so AC membership is unconfirmed and it is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

notes: Identity and extent confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page (No. 21, Nehtaur, SC, Bijnor district, Nagina Lok Sabha). Haldaur is inside the AC (Haldaur KC and municipal board, Bijnor tehsil); no Haldaur-specific sourced item was found. Jalalabad is not in the extent and was not used. Positives 1-4 all come from one Amar Ujala article (1 Sep 2026) whose speakers are unnamed traders and residents; the article contains no civic complaints, so these are thin and need a field check. Positive 5 is from 2023 and its continued operation is unverified. The MLA-praise item was dropped because it is not a delivered benefit. Only 2 of 5 negatives are AC-specific (railway gate and bus stand), short of the 3 required. Negatives 3-4 are district-level (BKU memorandum, Dhampur tehsil, no Nehtaur place named). Negative 5 is sourced but AC membership is unconfirmed. Not used: Hamidpur village road video (13 Jan 2025, Nahtaur block, Harpur gram panchayat; block is not AC and membership unconfirmed); Amar Ujala 29 Jul 2025 municipal expansion article (about 8 unnamed villages to join Nehtaur municipal board, no complaints); Patrika Bijnor flood article (dated 26 Aug 2018, district-level, Nahtaur not named); Bijnor bypass 92% headline (district-level, not Nehtaur-specific); Attewale Baba tourism tender in Nahtaur (tender notice, not a delivered benefit). Not cited because fetch failed earlier: NewsClick doctors-absent article (403) and shuru.co.in Nehtaur news page (404). Searched in Hindi and English (about 17 queries, plus Amar Ujala Bijnor section) with no sourced Nehtaur-specific item on water supply, drains or waterlogging, sugarcane dues or the local sugar mill, CHC or hospital staffing, Haldaur roads, or the Nahtaur overbridge. These are the main field-check gaps. The Dec 2019 CAA-protest killings in Nehtaur were not used because they are old and not a current voter issue.

round2.changes: Fetched all 7 article URLs and the Wikipedia AC page (identity and extent confirmed: Nehtaur KC with listed PCs and Nehtaur MB in Dhampur tehsil; Haldaur KC and Haldaur MB in Bijnor tehsil; Jalalabad is not in the extent). Negative 1 basis corrected: removed the unsupported 'shut again since early April' and '20 more days' claims and added the 27 Apr 2026 details. Negative 2 confirmed inside the AC. Negatives 3-4 labelled district-level with memorandum details. Negative 5 basis clarified, still unconfirmed. Positive 5 replaced: MLA praise (not a delivered benefit) swapped for restored Balawali-Nehtaur bus service (Amar Ujala, 24 Feb 2023). Summary and notes updated. No inference items.
